name: Suka's Curse
main_effect: [Main] 1 of your non-white Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Sukamon] in its name in your hand without paying the cost, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Until the end of your turn, change 1 of your opponent's Digimon into being white and having 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]
